g.text: FreeRTOS SMP Real-Time Architecture & Inter-Process Communication Engine
Heavy computational work (UART printing, JSON serialization, sensor filtering) is strictly deferred to worker tasks.

- Interrupt latency < 2.5 µs
- Zero RTOS queue jitter
- No stack frame corruption
- Deterministic preemption
Preemptive SMP Dual-Core Scheduler (Tick Rate: 1000 Hz / 1 ms)
Detects heap depletion and memory leaks.
Hardware sample acquisition, deferred GPTimer event handling.
Generates telemetry packets, writes to FIFO Queue with backpressure.
Periodic health telemetry, stack watermarks, Mutex-guarded serial log.
Low-power sleep • Cleans deleted task TCBs
